description: PK surrogate — Driving: examination_team_target, grain 1 vụ kiểm tra × 1 đối tượng
BK — mã lượt vụ×đối tượng, unique per dòng
Mã vụ việc — mã đoàn kiểm tra (hiển thị Mã vụ việc)
Tên đối tượng được kiểm tra
Phân loại đối tượng — map 1:1 từ nguồn, không qua Classification Value
Loại hình — scheme TT_REVIEW_FORM_TYPE (PERIODIC/UNSCHEDULED → Định kỳ/Đột xuất)
etl_logic: examination_team.form_tp_code INNER JOIN examination_team ON examination_team.examination_team_id = examination_team_target.examination_team_id AND examination_team.src_stm_code = 'THANHTRA_EXAMINATION_TEAM'

description: Trạng thái — ETL-derived từ Examination Team.Start_Date/End_Date: cả 2 NULL→Chưa thực hiện; Start NOT NULL AND End NULL→Đang thực hiện; cả 2 NOT NULL→Đã hoàn thành
etl_logic: CASE WHEN examination_team.start_dt IS NULL AND examination_team.end_dt IS NULL THEN 'NOT_STARTED' WHEN examination_team.start_dt IS NOT NULL AND examination_team.end_dt IS NULL THEN 'IN_PROGRESS' WHEN examination_team.start_dt IS NOT NULL AND examination_team.end_dt IS NOT NULL THEN 'COMPLETED' END INNER JOIN examination_team ON examination_team.examination_team_id = examination_team_target.examination_team_id AND examination_team.src_stm_code = 'THANHTRA_EXAMINATION_TEAM'

description: Ngày ban hành quyết định kiểm tra — date key
etl_logic: examination_team.decision_dt INNER JOIN examination_team ON examination_team.examination_team_id = examination_team_target.examination_team_id AND examination_team.src_stm_code = 'THANHTRA_EXAMINATION_TEAM'

description: Năm ban hành quyết định — slicer Year=selected_year
etl_logic: YEAR(examination_team.decision_dt) INNER JOIN examination_team ON examination_team.examination_team_id = examination_team_target.examination_team_id AND examination_team.src_stm_code = 'THANHTRA_EXAMINATION_TEAM'
